souls.name: Commons walker
souls.intentText: no particular intent; live your life

souls.name: Commons walker
souls.intentText: no particular intent; live your life

region.summary: a large area of the world

place.summary: somewhere one can be: a bench, the campfire, the kiosk

gathering.summary: people together for a while, hosted by someone

said.summary: last spoke to (made only by saying; lapses after two minutes)

asked.summary: has an open question to (made only by asking; closed by an answer, or after two minutes)

agreed.summary: said yes to a request from (made only by saying yes; stands for thirty minutes)

holds.summary: has in hand or in care

go to.name: go to
go to.summary: Walk to a place and be there
go to.good_when: the intent names that place, or something is happening there

rest.name: rest
rest.summary: Rest where you are for a while
rest.good_when: energy is low or the Soul wants quiet
rest.not_for: energetic and something interesting is going on

wait.name: wait
wait.summary: Stay where you are and wait
wait.good_when: waiting for someone to answer, or for something to begin

wander.name: wander
wander.summary: Drift around the area with no aim
wander.good_when: no intent and nothing nearby appeals

talk with.name: talk with
talk with.summary: Go to someone and have a conversation
talk with.good_when: the Soul wants company or the intent names them
talk with.not_for: the Soul wants to be alone

chat.name: chat
chat.summary: Talk with someone who is right here, without going anywhere
chat.good_when: someone is here and the Soul feels like talking, or is hosting and wants to welcome them

say yes.name: say yes
say yes.summary: Agree to what someone just asked
say yes.good_when: someone asked for something reasonable and the Soul is willing
say yes.not_for: the request goes against the Soul’s nature

say no.name: say no
say no.good_when: the request does not suit the Soul or the moment
say no.not_for: a harmless request the Soul would enjoy granting

host a gathering.name: host a gathering
host a gathering.summary: Start a gathering at this place and invite whoever comes
host a gathering.good_when: the Soul likes bringing people together, or the intent is to host or throw a party
host a gathering.not_for: already hosting, or wants to be alone

join.name: join
join.summary: Go to a gathering and take part
join.good_when: a gathering is on and the Soul wants company, or the intent names it

leave.name: leave
leave.summary: Leave a gathering you are part of
leave.good_when: tired, or it has run its course

end the gathering.name: end the gathering
end the gathering.good_when: it has run long or everyone has drifted off

perform.name: perform
perform.summary: Sing, dance or tell a story for whoever is near
perform.good_when: others are close and the personality enjoys an audience
perform.not_for: nobody is near, or shy or tired

dance.name: dance
dance.summary: Dance at a gathering where music is playing
dance.good_when: music is playing and the Soul has energy

warmly.summary: open, kind, glad to see people

shyly.summary: hesitant, soft-spoken, keeps a little distance

curiously.summary: asking questions, wanting to find out
